hoping.line: Raises his glass and says, "Here's to hoping"
stanza: And says, "Man, these things will kill me someday"
Raises his glass and says, "Here's to hoping"

hoping.line: A small gift of fulfillment I am hoping
stanza: Sinking ship, how long can you hold still?
Your illness is all that you are
A portrait of my father as a baby
A small pill of forgiveness I am giving to myself
A small gift of fulfillment I am hoping

hoping.line: I was hoping in my hoping
stanza: Where there were deserts I saw fountains
With none to laugh or criticize
And the leopard and the lamb
I was hoping in my hoping
To recall what I had found
